static_traits.name: Su Ting
static_traits.social_status: Has one good friend, but not yet discussed this Fear with them; reduced socializing and participation in dress-up Work events for fear of being judged.
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;without similar psychological problems in the past;not yet received psychotherapy.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; high cooperation,Positive attitude; emotionally Significant anxiety and self-focus; tending to jump to conclusions (mind reading, predicting the future) and negating positive feedback.

basic_info.main_problem: I am afraid of being mocked for preferring to wear black.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to resolve and overcome these negative thoughts through counseling, regain confidence, and no longer worry excessively about others' views.
growth_experiences: A few months ago at the company, a colleague commented on my all-black outfit; since then I have feared others' views of my appearance, gradually avoiding dress-up social and Work events. I believe this Fear stems from social norms and stereotypes about wearing black; it is especially strong when wearing black, accompanied by heightened Anxiety and self-consciousness.

core_beliefs: I will be mocked or negatively evaluated by others for wearing black

special_situations.event: In work or social activities requiring formal dress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show up in black, I will look like attending a funeral or not fitting in, and others will laugh at me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids joining activities, or wears brighter clothes instead to fit in
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will laugh at me and think I am strange

special_situations.event: A few months ago, a colleague commented on my all-black outfit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative comment shows that most people view my wearing black this way
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying hypervigilant since, constantly anticipating negative evaluations before going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Wearing black will be seen as attending a funeral or being out of place

special_situations.event: When I wear black to go out or think about going out wearing black
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go out wearing black, I will surely encounter negative reactions from others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearses worst-case scenarios before going out and changes into colorful clothes to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today someone will definitely laugh at me because of my black clothes

special_situations.event: Someone gives a positive comment on my black outfit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person compliments, it is just politeness and does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback, continuing to anticipate negative evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being perfunctory; inside they still look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to express oneself freely (preferring black clothing) and be accepted by others, not judged
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being ridiculed and rejected, losing social safety and career opportunities
defense_goal: By changing clothing and avoiding occasions, reduces the risk of negative evaluation by others and maintains a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily judged, vulnerable and not accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/groups who love to criticize and may mock oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out the positive feedback of others on their attire, or ask about others' real views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes that others' praise is only out of politeness, while inside she is still belittling or mocking herself (transference: imposing the inner negative evaluation onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone anxious yet certain, using affirmative sentences to assert others' negative intentions (like 'they are just being polite'); negating positive feedback interpretively, avoiding discussion of concrete evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the cause of fear or needing to describe emotional experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses the abstract explanation of 'social norms and stereotypes' to replace directly feeling their own emotions and needs (transference: keeping distance from emotion)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explaining in objective, neutral terms, reducing emotional wording; steady and somewhat distant tone, emphasizing conceptual explanation rather than subjective feelings.

manifestations: Prefers wearing black but worries about violating social norms and others' expectations
Tries wearing brighter clothes to fit in, sacrificing self-expression
outcomes: Anxiety and a sense of self-inconsistency

manifestations: Reduced socializing interactions for fear of being judged, keeping distance from friends and colleagues
outcomes: Decreased drive and Daily life affected

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Frequently attributing others' motives with 'they will laugh at me/look down on me'
Presetting others' negative evaluations without evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned with clothing and external evaluation, restricting himself from attending activities
Choosing avoidance for fear of mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treating 'society's stereotypes about black' as an inviolable rule
Changing clothing style to please others

exception_events.target_problem: When wearing black to social or Work occasions, the client usually presumes others' negative evaluations and develops Anxiety, thus avoiding participation
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few times when wearing black, others complimented her outfit, different from past anticipations, and no ridicule has appeared yet
exception_events.reason: Clues: since others directly expressed positive feedback at the time, the actual interaction provided supportive evidence, so no negative reaction appeared yet this time

positive_force: Has a close friend she can confide in (potential social support)
Has received positive feedback about wearing black (realistic evidence)
Proactively seeking help and willing to try recording and re-evaluation (strong motivation to change)
negative_force: Excessive jumping to conclusions (mind reading and predicting the future)
Negating positive feedback, reinforcing negative Anticipation
Introjecting social norms in an undigested way, repressing self-expression

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding dress-up social and Work events (with Significant anxiety and excessive self-consciousness)
antecedent: Invitations to or arrangements for formal-dress events
Wearing black to go out or thinking of wearing black out
Recalling a colleague's comment on the all-black outfit
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognitive bias of jumping to conclusions and predicting the future formed around one person's comment and focus on social stereotypes, fearing ridicule and negative evaluation
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential shame and the discomfort of being judged, maintaining short-term security
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, growing distant from friends, daily Increased anxiety and Decreased motivation
